articles.title: Héctor Rodas: “ Si alcanzamos la permanencia este año, estaremos cerca del 1:1”
articles.standfirst: El director deportivo del Levante confirma la llamada del Valencia en el último día de mercado por Etta Eyong
articles.summary: El director deportivo del Levante confirma la llamada del Valencia en el último día de mercado por Etta Eyong
articles.body: El director deportivo, Héctor Rodas, ha comparecido este mediodía en la sala de prensa del estadio Ciutat de Valencia tras el cierre del mercado de fichajes de verano para valorar las diferentes operaciones del Levante. “Ha sido un mercado muy intenso y hemos hecho muchas cosas. Dar las gracias a todo mi equipo y Danvila por el esfuerzo económico para hacer una plantilla competitiva. Ha sido un mercado muy complicado. Hemos empezado con un fair play de cinco millones que es muy complicado. hemos tenido que ser ingeniosos para hacer buscar una estabilidad y empezar nuevos procesos como la ciudad deportiva. Estoy muy satisfecho y contento del mercado. Hemos tenido un final bonito” “Etta es un gran activo. Hizo un inicio de temporada que llamó la atención, aunque después de la copa África resurgido Carlos Espí. Siempre que ha participado atenido muy buena actuación. Han llegado ofertas de diferentes clubes de países exóticos, premier, liga española…pero el jugador ha decidido quedarse e intentar sacar su mejor versión” “Tu imagínate que el club genera 100 millones de euros, pero la liga te dice que solo tienes 25 millones porque tienes que generar plusvalía. ¿Cómo consigues que esa cifra suba?, vendiendo jugadores, etc…el cómputo general nos ha permitido hacer una plantilla competitiva y gracias al esfuerzo económico de Danvila, hemos tenido un fair play digno. Vender por una cantidad de 40 millones de euros, no es fácil. Hemos recortado mucho de la herencia recibida” “Nosotros en las ultimas horas estábamos centrados en la inscripción de Petar Ratkov. Si hubiéramos tenido el saldo necesario para cerrarlo, lo hubiéramos hecho. Lo intentamos, desde enero estamos hablando pero le advertimos de nuestra situación” “Está traspasado a America. Tiene que solucionar algunas cosas con el equipo de destino. Cuando esté cerrado se hará oficial” “Nosotros tenemos que vender a nuestros activos y no es fácil traer las ofertas que hemos traído. Nosotros tratamos de mediar y él ha rechazado todas las propuestas.Para el club nos hubiera venido muy bien. Hubo una llamada del Valencia para preguntar por su situación, al igual que de otros equipos de Primera, pero tenemos que respetar su decisión. El Valencia pidió una información y ya no recibí ninguna llamada más” “Vamos a pelear por los que haga falta. En nuestra hoja de ruta contábamos en que no tenías saldo suficiente para poder hacer una operación. Tenemos a Cabello y a Toljan que pueden jugar en esa posición. Tenemos otras opciones si el mister decide que Manu Sánchez no debe jugar” “Yo estoy satisfecho igual. Yo creo que, con el Fair Play que tenemos y que estamos manejando, doblar dos jugadores por puestos, es complicado. Estoy muy satisfecho del trabajo, nos hemos sacrificado mucho” “El año pasado, al inicio de temporada, teníamos los mismo numero de delanteros que ahora. Queríamos un perfil de delantero como Carlos Espí. Llegamos mucho al área y queríamos un delantero con esas características” “Al final, por nuestra situación financiera, no podemos optar a por todo tipos de jugadores. Nosotros vendemos una ciudad espectacular y un ambiente impresionante y el míster aporta mucho. Luis consigue desarrollar muy bien a los jugadores y en ese cómputo, es muy importante” “La comparativa no sabría que decirte. Son perfiles diferentes y confío mucho en la plantilla de este año. Es verdad que, con Luís Castro desde el inicio, es un punto muy a favor. Partimos con esa cierta ventaja de que el míster ya conoce a la plantilla. No vivir con prisa y ansiedad por conocer a los jugadores y puntuar en cada partido, es muy importante” “Al final tengo documentos que demuestran que se hizo antes de las 12. La liga ha sido flexible en otros casos” “Teniendo fichas libres y teniendo algo de saldo, si existe alguna oportunidad, veremos si podemos hacer algo” “El primer año de Carlos en el Levante, rechazamos una oferta importante, aunque para luchar por el objetivo del ascenso, tenía que quedarse. América hizo una oferta muy grande y era una situación complicada, porque en pocos meses era agente libre. Hay muchas oportunidades pero al final surgió la oferta de México, que él vera con muy buenos ojos. Hay que recordarlo con buenos ojos porque nos ha dado mucho” “Hemos hecho la mejor plantilla con el presupuesto que teníamos. El entrenador está satisfecho. Aunque es verdad que no podemos decir que hemos hecho una buena plantilla, si al final no conseguimos el objetivo. Hemos hecho un gran esfuerzo y hemos hecho ventas muy complicadas” “Nosotros tenemos que ir a por talento joven. Este jugador lo seguimos durante mucho tiempo y en Youth League tenía mucho escaparate. Era un operación complicada porque aún tenía contrato. Queremos que sea un jugador de futuro y el mister lo ve cada día mucho mejor” “Pasamos una propuesta, aunque es cierto, que queremos que termine el mercado. A partir de ahora, iniciaremos diferentes operaciones con jugadores como Dela para que se pueda quedar nosotros durante muchos años” “Analizando la plantilla y, estando doblada la posición con Nacho Peréz y Toljan, el mister quería analizarlo. Hablamos con su entorno para decirle que lo mejor era buscarle una salida en forma de cesión. No nos hemos puesto de acuerdo al final y lo mejor es que salga del club” “Para hacer once fichajes hemos tenido que llamar a 50 jugadores. Como el año pasado con un portero que firmó por el Barça y se ha arrepentido. Este año la incertidumbre la marcaba el fair play. Hemos sido valientes pero la incertidumbre no lo llevamos muy bien. Nos gusta tenerlo todo controlado. Por suerte ha salido todo muy bien” “Confiamos mucho en nuestra cantero. Nos ha dado muchos frutos en los últimos años y queremos potenciarla. Queremos cuidarla lo máximo. Hemos hecho cambios en la Ciudad Deportiva de Buñol y en la residencia. Confiamos mucho en la cantera porque tiene que ser importante. En el caso de Marc, lo renovamos en marzo es un chico que siente el Levante como suyo. Queremos que el jugador juegue cada fin de semana y compita. Es lo mejor para su desarrollo” “Se debe a la incertidumbre del club. Hasta la última jornada no sabes donde estás, si en Primera o en Segunda. La gente sabe la situación que tenemos. Si fuera por mí, hubiéramos tenido a Espí, Arriaga o Carlos Espí. La situación del club es así. Tenemos que sanear al club de la mejor manera posible. Ahora mismo, no nos lo podemos permitir. Prioriza la necesidad que tiene el club” “Les diría que sigan creyendo y apoyando al equipo. Esta unión hacía años que no la veía. Yo veo a la gente que anima como nunca. El jugador lo nota. Puede ser muy importante, como el año pasado. Están todos para renovar un año más” “Viendo las alternativas que teníamos decimos ir a por otro tipo de perfil. Nosotros lo comunicamos. Él ha encontrado un destino como Málaga y le deseo lo mejor” “Si tuviese dinero hubiera comparo a los jugadores cedidos . Hasta que no tengamos la regla uno a uno, será así. No te da para más. Tienen un valor de mercado de 8 o 10 millones y un salario muy bajo. Dentro de nuestras posibilidades hay que caminar para que todos los jugadores que tengamos, tanto cedidos como en propiedad, busquen el equilibro” “Si este año logramos la permanencia, estamos más cerca del uno a uno. Tenemos penalizaciones del pasado en cualquier traspaso o un salario. Así se hace muy complicado” “El entorno no fue todo lo profesional que digamos. Yo soy virgen y no debo favores a nadie. Trabajamos con agencias y, en este caso, no volveremos a trabajar con ellos” “El año pasado lo pescamos y él, se lo tiene que ganar en el día a día. Es una apuesta del club, como Cabello. El Club confía en ellos, como yo en mi caso cuando era canterano. Sino tienes un bagaje hay que trabajar para ganarse el puesto” “En el mundial de Qatar lo destacamos. No pudimos acercarnos para nada. Era para conocerlo y valorarlo. Al igual que el delantero de Egipto del Barça también estaba allí. Pero conoces al entorno y cuando ya conoces al entorno, empieza a preguntar. Ivy hizo una buena pretemporada con el equipo y preguntamos su situación y surgió esta oportunidad. El mister se entrevistó con él y decidió venir al Levante, rechazando ofertas de otros equipos y pasases que pagaban más. No tiene cláusula de minutos y lo pueden repescar.

articles.title: Real Madrid summer signing wins over fans and teammates after just 161 minutes under Mourinho
articles.summary: Marc Cucurella did not have to wait long to make an impression at Real Madrid.The 28-year-old summer signing had to wait until the third matchday of the 2026...
articles.body:
Marc Cucurella did not have to wait long to make an impression at Real Madrid.

The 28-year-old summer signing had to wait until the third matchday of the 2026/27 La Liga season for his first start under Jose Mourinho.

However, by the time the final whistle was blown against Malaga, the Spanish full-back had already begun to establish himself as a popular figure within the dressing room and among the supporters.

Cucurella completed the full 90 minutes as Madrid secured a comfortable 4-0 victory over Malaga , following his second-half appearance in the 4-1 win against Real Sociedad.

Now, according to AS , the performance reinforced what had already been visible during his opening weeks at the club: Cucurella has arrived with the personality, intensity and reliability to fit into Mourinho's team.

The outlet mentions that Cucurella finished the Malaga match with 76 touches and 51 attempted passes, completing 46 of them for an 88.2% success rate.

He also created a scoring opportunity and was heavily involved defensively, making four tackles and recovering possession five times. He won an early aerial duel and blocked an opposition shot.

Notably, these statistics only tell part of the story.

The biggest reaction came from the stands, where Cucurella was applauded on several occasions.

His defensive work was also recognised by his teammates, who repeatedly acknowledged his contributions during the match.

As far as Mourinho is concerned, it is clear that the Portuguese manager wants his players to understand their defensive responsibilities, and Cucurella appears comfortable with the physical demands of that role.

He can defend against wingers, contribute in possession and still provide an attacking outlet from full-back.

That combination gives Mourinho a dependable option without requiring constant tactical adjustments.

A quick connection with the Madrid dressing room

Cucurella's adaptation has not been limited to what he does during matches.

Since arriving at Real Madrid, the defender has developed relationships within the squad and has regularly been seen joking with teammates during training.

His connection with Carlos Espi has been particularly noticeable, with the pair often together during warm-ups.

So far, Cucurella has played only 161 minutes across three appearances since joining Real Madrid, so it would be premature to make sweeping conclusions about his long-term role.

However, first impressions matter, and his have been difficult to improve upon.

articles.title: Lincoln Riley: 'I don't buy into the false narrative' surrounding the empty seats at USC's Week 0 win
articles.summary: There were more empty seats than fans at USC's win over San Jose State.
articles.body:
Lincoln Riley isn't going to get in a back-and-forth about the number of people who were at his team's Week 0 win.

USC beat San Jose State on Saturday to open the 2026 season in front of more empty seats than fans at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum. It was over 90 degrees and sunny in LA and, well, you can imagine how tempting the beach and other water-related activities would be compared to sitting in the sun for a game where the Trojans were a five-touchdown favorite.

Pictures of those empty seats went viral, however, and even forced USC to issue a statement about the lack of attendance . Riley was asked about the topic during his Tuesday news conference and dismissed the debate.

"This is USC, right? People are going to pay attention," Riley said. "People are going to have an opinion. It's part of being a blue-blood school. I don't buy into the false narrative. I think that comes from a lot of people that don't follow our program. And most of those who have never set foot in the Coliseum. The reality is during my years here, attendance has gone up every single year. As has our play in the Coliseum, including running the table last year in front of a lot of epic atmospheres and I expect that to happen again this year."

There are plenty of opportunities for the Coliseum to be full later in the season with home games against No. 2 Oregon, No. 17 Washington and No. 1 Ohio State all within the span of a month in the middle of the season. If fans aren't showing up for those games, then a legitimate debate is there to be had about USC fan support.

And let's be real, there are going to be myriad programs across the country who may also have more empty seats than normal in Week 1. Thanks to a heat dome across the southeast, heat indexes will be over 100 degrees in many college cities and towns.

The high in Austin, is set to be 96 for Texas' 3:30 p.m. ET kickoff against Texas State and the highs will be well into the 90s in places like Athens, Georgia, Tuscaloosa, Alabama, and Knoxville, Tennessee. If fans want to watch from home or in the shade by a pool, instead of going to a game against an inferior opponent, can you really blame them?

articles.title: El Atlético se lleva a Beltrán por su cláusula
articles.standfirst: El joven central abandona Butarque tras crecer desde cadete en la cantera pepinera
articles.summary: El joven central abandona Butarque tras crecer desde cadete en la cantera pepinera
articles.body: Beltrán Auguste Paolucci ya no pertenece al Leganés. El Atlético de Madrid abonó el último día de mercado la cláusula de rescisión del central hispano-argentino de 19 años, superior al millón de euros, para hacerse con uno de los jóvenes con mayor proyección de la cantera pepinera. Beltrán firmará hasta 2031, por el Atlético. Una operación que no gustó en Butarque por la apuesta realizada por el futbolista y por producirse mediante el pago de su cláusula al final del mercado de fichajes. Eso sí, supone el mayor ingreso del Leganés por un canterano que no había debutado oficialmente con el primer equipo de su historia. Auguste llegó al club en edad cadete y la pasada temporada dio el salto al filial siendo todavía juvenil. Este verano realizó la pretemporada con Rubén Albés y entró en las convocatorias de las dos primeras jornadas ante Girona y Real Oviedo. El Leganés pierde así una apuesta de futuro, aunque recibe una importante cantidad por un futbolista de sólo 19 años.

articles.title: El abonado del Villarreal mantiene su fidelidad en una Cerámica que este año crece
articles.standfirst: El Villarreal volverá a superar los 19.000 fieles mientras que el aforo de su estadio asciende hasta los 23. 173espectadores
articles.summary: El Villarreal volverá a superar los 19.000 fieles mientras que el aforo de su estadio asciende hasta los 23. 173espectadores
articles.body: El Villarreal CF volverá a contar esta temporada con el respaldo de más de 19.000 abonados, una cifra que confirma la fidelidad de su afición y mantiene la tendencia registrada durante los últimos años, en los que el club ha rondado habitualmente los 20.000 carnés. Este dato cobra especial relevancia después de los cambios y trabajos realizados durante el verano con motivo de la remodelación del Estadio de la Cerámica. Las actuaciones han permitido mejorar diferentes aspectos del recinto, especialmente los accesos y las condiciones de seguridad. Además, el aumento de precios de los abonos no ha afectado de forma significativa al número de abonados. Además, las obras han permitido ampliar la capacidad del estadio, que pasa a tener un aforo de 23.173 espectadores. De esta manera, se recuperan parte de los asientos que no pudieron utilizarse durante la pasada temporada. El nuevo reparto del estadio contempla algo más de 21.000 localidades destinadas a la afición local y alrededor de 2.000 plazas para los seguidores visitantes. La pasada campaña, más de 600 asientos de la zona reservada a las aficiones rivales no estuvieron disponibles, una situación que ha quedado resuelta tras la remodelación, permitiendo utilizar nuevamente toda la grada. Este próximo sábado será el estreno del estadio amarillo en la presente temporada con la visita del Deportivo de La Coruña. Los castellonenses han disputado los tres primeros partidos del campeonato a domicilio a causa de las obras

articles.title: Sergio Martínez se estrena con el primer equipo
articles.standfirst: El medio recién fichado del Racing se ejercitó a las órdenes de José Mourinho
articles.summary: El medio recién fichado del Racing se ejercitó a las órdenes de José Mourinho
articles.body: Segundo entrenamiento del Real Madrid de cara a la vista al Betis en La Cartuja (viernes, 21.00 horas). La principal novedad fue la presencia en la sesión de Sergio Martínez, el centrocampista de 19 años fichado del Racing el pasado 31 de agosto. Sergio Martínez, por el que el Madrid pagó unos tres millones de euros, llega para incorporarse en principio al Castilla, aunque la intención es que se deje ver por las sesiones de la primera plantilla para que José Mourinho pueda estar pendiente de su evolución. Con contrato hasta 2023, ha sido la gran apuesta del club para el primer filial blanco. Por lo demás, Tchouameni, Asencio, Mendy, Militão, Rodrygo, Endrick y Thiago continúan con sus procesos de recuperación. No se prevén novedades en la lista de este jueves ante el Betis, a la que no debe llgar ninguno de los jugadores que siguen al margen del grupo.

articles.title: Everton's transfer deadline day debacle leaves owners facing fan mutiny
articles.summary: Everton's transfer deadline day debacle over Folarin Balogun leaves owners The Friedkin facing fan mutiny, says chief football writer Phil McNulty.
articles.body:
Everton 's shambolic end to the transfer window has resulted in open revolt from supporters that places fierce scrutiny on owners The Friedkin Group and chief executive Angus Kinnear.

The last straw for fans already infuriated by the controversial proposed sale of home-grown youngster Harrison Armstrong to Nottingham Forest - the deal was eventually blocked by Everton 's board in the face of the toxic reaction from the fanbase - was the bungled final day before the window closed.

Folarin Balogun's proposed £40m move from AS Monaco descended into high farce in the early hours of Wednesday morning after the original deal was renegotiated when issues arose with his medical, ending with the United States striker deciding to walk away from Everton's Finch Farm training base without signing.

And all after Balogun, 25, and both clubs had signed the deal sheet allowing the move to be completed after Tuesday's 23.00 BST transfer deadline.

Everton had scheduled an 8am flight to bring Balogun to Merseyside, but he was unable to arrive until later in the day. Everton were also frustrated at a delay in receiving documents related to the deal from Monaco.

When the problem with his medical cropped up, it prompted Everton to pursue a loan deal for Manchester United 's Joshua Zirkzee, who was happy to sign but was not allowed to leave Old Trafford. A move was also made for Aston Villa 's Tammy Abraham but did not progress as the striker wished to remain at Villa Park.

After failing to sign an alternative, a deal was eventually agreed with Monaco, minutes before the deadline, which would have resulted in a smaller up-front payment and a series of triggered payments based on how he progressed. The player's personal terms were unchanged.

It was only then that the former Arsenal striker had his change of heart, leaving Finch Farm with Monaco sporting director Thiago Scuro telling journalists at a news conference on Wednesday that Balogun was "not comfortable" with how Everton treated him during his medical.

Everton believe they supported Balogun throughout the process, while being open about the issues identified. The club also made clear to the player they would work with Monaco to explore a solution that could still enable the transfer to be completed.

To make matters worse, and to shed an even more unflattering light on the club's strategy and operation, it all came after hours after Everton had sanctioned striker Beto's £15.5m move to Fiorentina.

Events unfolded as Everton 's most creative player Iliman Ndiaye was completing his £65m move to Manchester City .

Everton could point to the fact Balogun took a personal decision they could not reverse, but the bigger question is why they took until the final day of the window to address glaring long-term issues?

Kinnear, in what must now be looked upon as an ill-fated recent interview with BBC Radio Merseyside, announced Everton 's squad was "in a good place", adding: "The challenge is we want to get the absolute best player we can in their position. Our metric is that by the close of the transfer window we have achieved that."

He also relayed the views of Everton 's American owners that they regarded missing out on Europe last season as "failure". It was an announcement manager David Moyes admitted came as a "surprise".

After the events of recent days, the word "failure" is being applied to the owners and chief executive, not Moyes. And there will be no hiding place for TFG and Kinnear should things now go wrong.

The "good place" Kinnear spoke about has eventually amounted to leaving Moyes with just one striker in the raw Thierno Barry and only 18 senior, outfield players, a parlous state of affairs for the 63-year-old Scot, who has at times found it hard to disguise his dissatisfaction with the extent of the summer's transfer business.

Everton may have re-signed Jack Grealish on loan, and finally solved a right-back problem stretching back years by signing Ashley Maitland-Niles from Lyon for £3m, but the over-riding verdict on the club's transfer window has to be one of huge embarrassment for TFG and Kinnear.

Even the search for a right-back, a problem from last summer and further back, was not smooth, with Maitland-Niles being officially announced shortly after midnight after a £9.4m deal for Fulham 's Kenny Tete was shelved when the Cottagers could not find a suitable replacement.

As well as only one striker in Barry, Everton 's squad now has just one recognised right-back in Maitland-Niles and one left-back in Vitaliy Mykolenko after youngster Adam Aznou was allowed to join Malaga on loan.

The last few days have seen one major PR catastrophe narrowly avoided by pulling out of the sale of 19-year-old Armstrong, arguably Everton 's most promising academy product since Wayne Rooney, only to walk straight into another, highly damaging one.

After the Carabao Cup second-round win at Preston North End, Moyes said: "I still think we have got a lot of work to do. We need more players. Our squad is not big enough and we need to get more quality in some areas if we can do."

Moyes' thoughts will be worth much more than a penny, should he choose to air them publicly, while fans' groups have wasted no time in expressing their undisguised anger, with a petition even set up calling for Kinnear's resignation.

"The Everton Fans' Forum" issued a lengthy statement featuring widescale criticism of the club, saying the Toffees' squad had been left "dangerously short" in key areas.

It added: "The conclusion of this summer's transfer window leaves Everton supporters with serious questions about the club's planning, recruitment and decision-making.

"This is not about demanding that Everton spend recklessly. Supporters understand the financial restrictions the club operates under. We are not demanding marquee signings simply for the sake of it.

"We are demanding competence, preparation and accountability."

And the influential group "The 1878s", volunteers who have created huge flags, banners and tifos to enhance the atmosphere at Everton 's new Hill Dickinson Stadium, and whose efforts were described as "unbelievable" by Moyes, has responded to deadline day in similar vein.

In a statement it said it is "standing down for the foreseeable future" in protest, saying: "Like the rest of our fanbase, we are utterly disappointed and disgusted with how this transfer window has gone, especially the end of it.

"Also for fans asking, just to reiterate - when we design flags, there are rules and regulations that we have to adhere to regarding the wording on our flags during displays, we are not allowed derogatory or offensive wording or images.

"If we were able to get a load of flags in the ground to show our feelings of discontent, disappointment and anger over this whole situation, believe us, we would, but this is something that simply wouldn't be allowed."

As well as the last-day signings of Grealish and Maitland-Niles, Everton did make other acquisitions during the window, bringing in PFA Championship Player of the Year Hayden Hackney from Middlesbrough.

Christian Norgaard was signed from Arsenal - although the 32-year-old Dane is currently injured with no comeback date - as a replacement for departed veteran Idrissa Gueye.

Deals for young German Merlin Rohl and England Under-21 winger Tyrique George, on loan last season, were confirmed. Brennan Johnson arrived from Crystal Palace in a straight swap with Dwight McNeil.

All this, however, has been overshadowed by a transfer deadline day that ended as nothing short of a debacle. In reality, they have ended this transfer markedly weaker than when they started it.

Everton are yet to issue any public statement on the events that have led to such damning criticism, fan rebellion and a loss of credibility for owners TFG - but there are many fences to be mended.

If that can be done successfully remains to be seen.

articles.title: Will Illinois-Missouri football rivalry actually return in 2027?
articles.summary: Braggin’ Rights on the gridiron?
articles.body:
The wait continues to find out when and where the 2027 football matchup between Illinois and Missouri will take place. Josh Whitman told the press on July 25 that the location has yet to be discussed and needs to be addressed soon.

"Not today," Whitman said when asked about the location of the 2027 game.

Kansas City, Chicago, St. Louis, Nashville, or either Champaign or Columbia are realistic options for the first game of the series.

As of now, the 2028 game is scheduled to be played in Champaign, while the 2029 game will be in Columbia. A neutral-site game would make the most sense for the first game of the new series, unless the schools want to move everything up a season and play the 2029 matchup at a neutral site.

The Illinois vs. Mizzou game was played in St. Louis for six straight seasons, and the former Rams stadium is still there, making it an easy choice. St. Louis is roughly in the middle of both campuses and would mirror the annual basketball matchup that has been played in the city for more than five decades.

The lack of discussion regarding the location is not particularly encouraging, especially after the reduction in games that was announced in the summer of 2025.

Illinois and Missouri originally announced plans to renew the rivalry all the way back in 2017. The first game was set to be played Sept. 26, 2026 — just a few weeks from now. Those plans were changed when an eight-year series was announced in 2020 but reduced to six games in 2025.

The original agreement between the two schools was as follows:

Sept. 26, 2026 — Champaign, Ill. Sept. 18, 2027 — Columbia, Mo. Sept. 16, 2028 — Champaign, Ill. Sept. 15, 2029 — Columbia, Mo. Sept. 18, 2032 — Champaign, Ill. Sept. 17, 2033 — Columbia, Mo. Sept. 16, 2034 — Champaign, Ill. Sept. 15, 2035 — Columbia, Mo.

The new agreement made last summer reduced the series from eight games to six, canceling the 2026 and 2032 matchups. The cancellation was agreed to by both sides and was largely due to both teams already having a power-conference opponent on their non-conference schedules for those seasons. The Illini have Duke at home in 2026, while the Tigers have Kansas on the docket for both 2026 and 2032.

The new contract between Illinois and Missouri looks similar:

2027 (Date TBD) — Site TBD Sept. 16, 2028 — Champaign, Ill. Sept. 15, 2029 — Columbia, Mo. 2033 (Date TBD) — Site TBD Sept. 16, 2034 — Champaign, Ill. Sept. 15, 2035 — Columbia, Mo.

Neither team has a Power Four opponent already scheduled during these six seasons, so it would be great to see this rivalry return in any form possible. Missouri has historically dominated Illinois and leads the all-time series 17-7, but the Illini have gotten much better in recent years.

This series would be great for the fans and great for college football, giving the sport a high-level matchup early in the season. The SEC is now required to play a Power Four opponent during non-conference play every season, while the Big Ten has yet to enforce a similar rule.There is no reason for Missouri to back out of this series with that rule coming into effect, so hopefully Illinois keeps its word and plays the game in 2027.

There is no need to panic yet, but hopefully we learn more about the location of the 2027 game — and the future of the series as a whole — over the next few months.
